explicitExclusions.reason: Third-party dependency source was excluded from line-by-line review; resolved production dependencies were checked with pnpm audit.
Generated WXT intermediates were excluded from source review; the resulting production manifest and archive contents were separately asserted.
Generated unpacked extension output was excluded from line-by-line review; it was exercised by MV3 end-to-end and visual tests.
Generated reports, screenshots, and release archives were treated as validation outputs rather than executable source.

surfaces.label: Sleeper request boundary, response limits, and exact identity binding
surfaces.notes: All Sleeper requests are allowlisted GETs; byte/shape limits and account, league, roster, draft, and season identity checks are enforced and live-audited.

surfaces.label: Runtime sender validation and per-tab live-draft isolation
surfaces.notes: Content-script capabilities are allowlisted, side-panel ports are extension-origin checked, and draft state is keyed and broadcast by subscribed tab.

surfaces.label: Account, league, season, workspace, active selection, and mock-draft storage isolation
surfaces.notes: Version 4 composite identities, injective storage keys, exact load validation, and stale-selection commit guards are covered by regression tests.

surfaces.label: Provider-key lifecycle, permissions, redaction, and AI request handling
surfaces.notes: Keys default to trusted session storage, status is masked through the worker, AI hosts are optional permissions, diagnostics redact credentials, and provider calls use bounded structured contracts.

surfaces.label: Research source policy, citations, manual-odds legal pool, and external navigation
surfaces.notes: Official/trusted allowlists, optional social opt-in, blocked-domain filtering, secret-bearing URL rejection, confirmation interstitials, and nonempty legal-player gates are enforced.
surfaces.riskArea: Unsafe external content and fail-open analysis

surfaces.label: User imports, diagnostics, logging, and local alert outputs
surfaces.notes: Size/depth/field limits, spreadsheet formula neutralization, credential detection, aliases, and redacted diagnostics are tested.
surfaces.riskArea: Injection, formula execution, and sensitive-data leakage

surfaces.label: Manifest permissions, content security policy, packaged contents, and dependencies
surfaces.notes: No activeTab/tabs permission, AI origins are optional, extension pages use strict self-only CSP, no source maps are packaged, and the production audit reports no known vulnerabilities.
surfaces.riskArea: Extension platform exposure and supply chain

surfaces.label: Draft legality, roster feasibility, traded-pick ownership, and AI fallback behavior
surfaces.notes: Centralized position eligibility, bipartite roster feasibility, exact pick ownership, bounded AI overlays, and Luna-first fallback are covered by 5,000 simulations and 1,212 live-data mock picks.
